content.text:
Done. Filtered story charts now use the filtered data’s x-axis as-is.

Previously, `alignChartDataToBaselineX` padded missing categories with zeros so the full baseline domain stayed visible — which looked wrong for date-range filters. That alignment (and its helper) is removed; charts just render the filtered rows.
